# Recommendation Memo

**Use it when:** the client wants everything and you have to pick one thing.
**It exists to stop:** a six-month build that nobody can evaluate until month six.

> *A list of eleven wants is not a roadmap. The first build is the one where the pain
> is frequent, measurable, and owned by somebody who will actually use the fix.*

**One page. If it is two pages, it is not a recommendation, it is a proposal.**

---
